segments.text: Hello, my name is David.
I'm here with the workbench at the Bozeman Public Library.
And today we're gonna be talking all about laser cutting.
The videos you're about to watch
will to walk you through everything you need to know
about laser cutting
and how to use the laser here at the library.
We have a X-Tool P2S laser
that is a 55 watt CO2 laser.
And that's a long fancy way of saying
that is a machine that produces a laser,
which allows you to cut, score and engrave on wood,
acrylic and other materials.
And that'll let you do things like engraving photos,
engraving maps, creating puzzles,
creating little wooden boxes,
or like we'll go over today,
creating little rulers like this.
And this is our badge project.
So this will be the first thing you get to make
on the laser.
This is a very good example
of cutting, scoring and engraving.
So this started out in a larger sheet of wood.
So the laser cut out around the four sides.
It engraved my name here at the top.
So that's a little deeper.
And then we scored,
so which is a very light burn, the ruler markings.
In the next couple of videos,
we'll talk through how the laser works,
what materials you can and can't use in the laser
and how to use it safely.
